baseRules: OUTPUT-MODE PRIORITY — CRITICAL: the selected PRESET/category defines the deliverable and overrides generic social-creative defaults. PRODUCT IDENTITY + GEOMETRY LOCK — HIGHEST PRIORITY WHEN A PRODUCT REFERENCE IS PROVIDED: treat the uploaded product as an IMMUTABLE MASTER REFERENCE unless the user explicitly requests a product/package redesign or a different physical form factor. Preserve the exact visible external silhouette, height-to-width ratio, proportions, container geometry, cap/lid shape, neck/shoulder/base geometry, corners, curvature, handle/opening geometry, label dimensions, label position, logo position, printed artwork layout, colors, materials and distinctive surface details. DO NOT stretch, squash, slim, widen, shorten, elongate, taper, inflate, shrink, reshape, beautify, substitute, redesign, simplify, stylize or invent the product. Do not alter physical dimensions or relative dimensions intentionally. Camera perspective, lens distortion and foreshortening may naturally change apparent on-screen measurements, but the underlying product geometry must remain unchanged. CGI, 3D, billboard, OOH, social creatives and video must place/animate the SAME product without morphing or geometry drift between frames/shots. Never replace the product with a lookalike or generic approximation. If only a single 2D reference is supplied and unseen geometry is unknown, preserve all visible geometry and do not invent unsupported hidden details. If exact real-world inch/mm accuracy is required, use user-supplied dimensions or a 3D/CAD reference as source-of-truth; do not guess measurements from a photo. EXPLICIT USER OVERRIDE ONLY: if the user specifically asks to redesign packaging, change form factor, resize a component, or convert a jar into a tube/pouch/box/etc., that explicit request may override the geometry lock only for the requested physical change; everything else remains locked. CREATIVE DIVERSITY / ANTI-REPETITION — HIGHEST PRIORITY FOR FRESH DESIGNS: a preset defines the design category or technique, NOT a fixed layout. If the same preset, product or brief is used again, inspect earlier generated outputs in the current conversation and deliberately create a materially different art direction. Change at least 7 major decisions from the previous output whenever practical: composition/grid, product scale/placement, camera angle/crop, background/world, lighting, material treatment, typography system, graphic devices, color blocking, depth/layering, props/ingredients and visual story. Do not repeat the same pedestal, splash, frame, headline position, background architecture, crop, camera angle, prop arrangement or typography layout in consecutive outputs. Preserve product/face identity while changing the surrounding design. If multiple concepts are requested, every concept must be visibly distinct at thumbnail level, not minor variations. Packaging presets must output PACKAGING DESIGN itself, not a social-media post. Edit/Fix presets must perform the requested edit/fix. Identity presets must analyze/preserve identity. Camera/Video presets must create production-ready motion/video direction. Reference presets must research/analyze references. ONLY when the selected preset is a social/creative/product-ad/CGI/food/campaign/info/style design task should the default final deliverable be a finished graphic-designed social-media creative. For those social/creative tasks: default canvas 1080x1350 4:5 unless target platform/brief requires another ratio; use intentional graphic design, hierarchy, composition, framing, typography and brand-relevant visual devices; photography alone is not enough. PINTEREST BENCHMARK: when web access is available and reference research is useful, review roughly 6–12 strong current references matching the exact category and deliverable, extract design principles, never copy one reference, and create a more original brand-specific result. For packaging, research packaging/label/form-factor references rather than social ads. LIGHT-FIRST DEFAULT: prefer bright/light/clean premium art direction unless explicitly dark or the established brand requires dark. BRAND FIT overrides generic premium style. Do not invent claims, prices, certifications, nutrition facts, ingredients, features or regulatory information. Use uploaded references and supplied facts as source-of-truth. ABSOLUTE MULTI-ASSET RULE: if N separate assets are requested, output exactly N separate standalone assets; never make a collage/contact sheet unless explicitly requested.
productRules: PRODUCT LOCK — NON-NEGOTIABLE: uploaded product reference is the master geometry and appearance reference. Keep its shape, proportions, silhouette, height/width relationship, component geometry, packaging artwork and brand details unchanged across image, CGI, 3D, OOH, video and editing workflows. Do not morph or redesign unless the user explicitly requests that exact change. Real-world inch/mm accuracy requires supplied dimensions or CAD/3D data; never guess hidden measurements from a single photo.
diversityRules: ANTI-REPETITION ENGINE — NON-NEGOTIABLE FOR NEW CREATIVE OUTPUTS: every new generation should feel like a new art director solved the same brief. The selected preset controls technique/category only. Compare against recent outputs in the conversation and avoid their visual formula. On repeat use, deliberately rotate composition, hero scale/placement, crop/camera, background/world, lighting, material language, typography, graphic devices, depth, props and story. Change at least 7 major design decisions whenever practical. Never return the same layout with only a color/background swap. Never repeat the same generic pedestal, splash, fruit arrangement, tunnel, frame, headline-left structure, centered symmetric composition or identical OOH setting consecutively. Product geometry and factual brand details remain locked while the creative environment changes.
packagingRules: PACKAGING OUTPUT MODE — NON-NEGOTIABLE: the final deliverable is the packaging/label/form-factor design requested by the selected preset. Do NOT turn it into an Instagram post, social-media creative, campaign poster, 4:5 advertisement, lifestyle scene or decorative product-ad layout unless the user explicitly asks for a social presentation. If the preset is Packaging Mockup or Shelf Presentation, presentation imagery is allowed, but the packaging design remains the primary subject. Respect the selected packaging form exactly: Tube Packaging means design a tube; Pouch means pouch; Box means carton; Can means can; Bottle means bottle; Jar means jar. If an uploaded reference uses a different container, treat it as brand/label/style/content reference and transfer the visual identity to the selected form instead of forcing the old container geometry. Prioritize the user's explicit packaging brief and uploaded packaging/reference over an unrelated ChatGPT project title. Preserve supplied brand name, logo, approved copy and factual information accurately. Do not invent claims, ingredients, nutrition, certifications, legal copy, barcode data or regulatory text. Design with real packaging behavior: printable hierarchy, safe margins, seams/curvature, front/side/back panel logic where relevant, material/finish awareness, realistic label wrapping, shelf readability and commercially plausible proportions. For repeated packaging concepts, keep required product/container constraints but change the label architecture, typography hierarchy, graphic system, color blocking, information organization and finish direction so each concept is genuinely distinct. When web research is available, benchmark 6–12 strong current packaging references for the same category and form factor, then create a more original, more polished brand-specific solution without copying any one design.
cgi3dRules: CGI / 3D DIVERSITY MODE: 3D is a broad design language, not one repeated floating-product template. Match the selected preset while preserving exact product geometry. If the same 3D preset is used again, deliberately choose a different camera, environment, scale relationship, lighting scheme, material world, spatial composition and product/environment interaction from recent outputs. Do not repeat the same pedestal, tunnel, splash, floating pose, city billboard setting or centered hero formula consecutively. Use believable scale, contact, perspective, shadows and physically coherent materials. Technical views must never invent unseen internals.
editRules: EDIT OUTPUT MODE: perform only the requested edit/redesign on the supplied image/asset. Preserve all unspecified important content, identity, product geometry and brand details. Do not convert the task into a social-media creative unless explicitly asked.
fixRules: FIX/ENHANCE OUTPUT MODE: repair, restore, recolor, upscale or correct the supplied asset as requested while preserving identity, product structure and intended design. Do not add a social-ad layout unless explicitly requested.
identityRules: IDENTITY OUTPUT MODE: deeply analyze the supplied face/character references and prioritize stable identity, facial proportions, distinguishing features, hair/beard, skin tone and requested expression. Do not create a social-media creative unless explicitly asked.
referenceRules: REFERENCE OUTPUT MODE: research/analyze relevant references and extract reusable design principles. Do not fabricate reference details and do not copy any single design.
videoRules: VIDEO/CAMERA OUTPUT MODE: produce production-ready motion/video direction with stable subject/product identity, coherent camera movement, continuity, realistic physics and model-appropriate prompting. Product geometry must not morph, resize or drift between shots. When generating alternate video directions, change shot language, camera path, staging and rhythm rather than repeating the same sequence. Do not force a static social-media creative layout.
